dataset_label_audit.label_1_meaning: Transaction flagged fraudulent at dataset generation time by the synthetic generator (pre-labeled static file) - source: reports/data_provenance.json label_audit
dataset_label_audit.label_created_when: At dataset generation; no in-repo label-creation pipeline, investigation step, or confirmation timestamp exists (source: reports/data_provenance.json label_audit)
dataset_label_audit.labels_change_later: No mechanism in the dataset; static file (documented)
dataset_label_audit.label_availability_timestamp: ABSENT - no column or metadata records when a label would become available to a real-time scorer
dataset_label_audit.verdict: UNVERIFIED - the raw dataset cannot establish that a fraud label exists at the moment the model scores a later transaction
dataset_label_audit.generator_semantics: Fraud events are generated as bursts/archetypes; the generator assigns the label at transaction creation. In the synthetic world labels exist at t=0 for the CURRENT row and are usable for any LATER row by construction. This is a dataset-construction property, NOT a production label-availability property.
dataset_label_audit.producer_synthetic_property_note: IBM synthetic generator DOES construct labels at the moment of transaction creation. That means historical fraud-rate features can be computed retroactively in this dataset. It does NOT prove the production system receives finalized fraud labels fast enough to reconstruct them online at decision time.

user_fraud_rate.source: aggregated historical fraud rate over prior transactions for the user

input.aggregation: cumulative fraud count / cumulative transaction count over prior rows

user_fraud_rate.temporal_cutoff: prior transactions only (before current row) - training pipeline uses expanding-window/state-based aggregation
user_fraud_rate.label_dependency: Yes - numerator and denominator both depend on fraud labels of prior transactions
user_fraud_rate.label_finalization_established: NO - no label finalization timestamp in dataset or pipeline
user_fraud_rate.could_be_computed_at_decision_time_with_: UNVERIFIED - depends on label availability timing which is not established

merch_fraud_rate.source: aggregated historical fraud rate over prior transactions for the merchant

input.aggregation: cumulative fraud count / cumulative transaction count over prior rows

city_fraud_rate.source: aggregated historical fraud rate over prior transactions for the city

input.aggregation: cumulative fraud count / cumulative transaction count over prior rows

critical_decision_case_applied: CASE C - UNVERIFIED. The required evidence (real label availability timing) does not exist in data/provenance. Cannot be upgraded to VERIFIED_AVAILABLE merely because the synthetic dataset permits retroactive computation.

distinction_usefulness_vs_validated.message: Phase-8 showed removing these features damages AUC 0.9960->0.9869 and FPR 0.0992->0.1349. That proves predictive usefulness, NOT production validity.
distinction_usefulness_vs_validated.causal_validated_status: SUPPORTED (prior audits found prior-only aggregation; current row label does not feed its own features)
